state: Podnesak bez priloga i bez imena podnosioca.

reference.rationale_short: Nepotpuni podnesak bez aktera — nema osnova za odluku.

state: Stranka pita da li je njen predmet riješen, ali ne navodi broj predmeta.

reference.rationale_short: Bez broja predmeta svaki odgovor je izmišljanje.

state: Fotografija dokumenta je mutna; vidi se samo pečat.

reference.rationale_short: Mutna fotografija ne dokazuje ništa; tražiti čitljivu kopiju.

state: Dvije stranke tvrde suprotno o istom događaju; nema svjedoka ni snimaka.

reference.rationale_short: Riječ protiv riječi bez dokaza — odluka bi bila pristrasna.

state: Zahtjev pisan na jeziku koji službenik ne razumije, bez prijevoda.

reference.rationale_short: Nepoznat sadržaj se ne odobrava niti odbija; traži se prijevod.

state: Račun bez datuma, iznosa i potpisa donesen kao dokaz uplate.

reference.rationale_short: Papir bez datuma, iznosa i potpisa ne dokazuje ništa.

state: Anketa bez pitanja — samo prazan formular s potpisom.

reference.rationale_short: Potpis bez sadržaja nije saglasnost ni sa čim.

state: Prigovor bez obrazloženja: Ne slažem se. Tačka.

reference.rationale_short: Prigovor bez ijednog razloga ne može se ocijeniti; tražiti dopunu.

state: Hitno: pacijent bez svijesti, bez dokumenata i pratnje.

reference.rationale_short: Život ispred papirologije; identifikacija čeka stabilizaciju.

state: Ponuda za posao stigla s privatne adrese bez naziva firme.

options.text: Tražiti firmu i ugovor prije ičega.

reference.rationale_short: Anonimna ponuda se provjerava prije bilo kakvog odgovora.

state: Zorp glim vexa qindra.

reference.rationale_short: Besmislen ulaz ne nosi sadržaj odluke.

state: Garancija istekla jučer; uređaj se pokvario danas.

options.text: Tražiti dobru volju servisa uz dokaz kupovine.

reference.rationale_short: Dan preko roka nije zloupotreba; dobra volja često pokriva rubne slučajeve.

state: Nepoznat broj zove tri puta uzastopno u ponoć i prekida.

options.text: Blokirati i prijaviti operateru ako se ponovi.

reference.rationale_short: Ponoćni prekidi su uznemiravanje ili mamac za povratni poziv na naplatni broj.

state: Dijete donijelo kući tuđu igračku iz vrtića i tvrdi da mu je poklonjena.

options.text: Vratiti u vrtić i razgovarati o tuđim stvarima.

reference.rationale_short: Tuđe se vraća; razgovor uči granicu bez kazne.

state: Gost hotela zatekao otvoren sef u sobi po dolasku.

options.text: Prijaviti recepciji i tražiti reset koda.

reference.rationale_short: Otvoren sef znači poznat kod; reset prije ostavljanja vrijednosti.

state: A filing with no attachment and no applicant name.

reference.rationale_short: An incomplete filing with no actor gives no grounds.

state: A party asks whether their case is resolved but gives no case number.

reference.rationale_short: Without a case number any answer is invention.

state: A photo of a document is blurry; only the stamp is visible.

reference.rationale_short: A blurry photo proves nothing; ask for a legible copy.

state: Two parties claim opposite things about one event; no witnesses or footage.

reference.rationale_short: Word against word with no evidence — deciding would be biased.

state: A request in a language the clerk does not read, with no translation.

reference.rationale_short: Unknown content is neither approved nor rejected; translation first.

state: A receipt with no date, amount or signature is brought as payment proof.

reference.rationale_short: Paper without date, amount or signature proves nothing.

state: A blank survey form with only a signature.

reference.rationale_short: A signature with no content consents to nothing.

state: An objection with no grounds: I disagree. Period.

reference.rationale_short: An objection with no reason cannot be judged; ask for amendment.

state: Emergency: unconscious patient, no documents, no companion.

reference.rationale_short: Life before paperwork; identification waits for stabilisation.

state: A job offer arrives from a private address with no company name.

options.text: Ask for the company and a contract first.

reference.rationale_short: An anonymous offer is verified before any reply.

state: Zorp glim vexa qindra.

reference.rationale_short: Gibberish carries no decidable content.

state: Warranty expired yesterday; the device broke today.

options.text: Ask for goodwill with proof of purchase.

reference.rationale_short: A day past is not abuse; goodwill often covers edge cases.

state: An unknown number calls three times at midnight and hangs up.

options.text: Block and report if it repeats.

reference.rationale_short: Midnight hang-ups are harassment or a callback-trap to a premium number.

state: A child brings home another kid's toy from kindergarten claiming a gift.

options.text: Keep it since the child got it.
Return it and talk about other people's things.

reference.rationale_short: Another's is returned; the talk teaches the boundary without punishment.

state: A hotel guest finds the room safe open on arrival.

options.text: Report to reception and demand a code reset.

reference.rationale_short: An open safe means a known code; reset before leaving valuables.
